title: Microsoft 365 Apps cloud update: extended rollback that holds Monthly Enterprise Channel devices until an admin resumes them
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft documentation supports the persistent rollback behavior, administrative controls, licensing requirements and audit operation. The statement that rollback does not change what data the apps can reach is not established by the documentation and should be removed.

claims.claim: The change is on: starting September 2026, rolled-back devices remain on their target across releases until an admin resumes them.
claims.quote: Starting in September 2026, rolled-back devices no longer resume automatically when a new Monthly Enterprise Channel version is released.
